name: Cucutime
description: Remote MCP server for personalized kids songs: draft a song for a child's first name and a theme, get Cucutime's name page and free-sample link, and search Cucutime's own kids songs and educational videos (es, pt, en). These three tools need no key and use no AI. The AI tools create_personalized_song and moderate_kids_text are for adult-facing apps only and need a free developer key sent as an Authorization: Bearer header, which this entry does not configure.
author: Cucutime
